title: Introducing yourself
questions: What is your name?
How old are you?
Where are you from?
sample: Hello! My **name** is Aziz and my **surname** is Karimov. I am sixteen years old. I am from Uzbekistan and I **live** in Tashkent. It is a big **city**. I am a **student**. I **speak** Uzbek and Russian, and I am learning English. Nice to meet you!

title: Countries and nationalities
grammar: to be: he is / she is / they are
questions: Where are you from?
What is your nationality?
What languages do you speak?
sample: I **come from** Uzbekistan. I am **Uzbek**. I was born in Samarkand, but now I live in the **capital**, Tashkent. My friend Kim is **foreign**. He is from Korea, so his **nationality** is Korean. My uncle lives **abroad**, in Turkey. I speak two languages, and I want to visit many countries.

title: Introducing each family member
questions: How many people are there in your family?
What are their names?
How old are they?

phrases.en: There are ... people in my family.

sample: There are six people in my family. This is my **father**. His name is Rustam and he is forty-five. My **mother** 's name is Dilnoza. I have got one **older** **brother** and one **younger** **sister**. My **brother** is twenty and my **sister** is ten. My **grandmother** lives with us too. I love my **parents** and my family very much.

title: My best friend
questions: Who is your best friend?
What is he or she like?
What do you do together?

phrases.en: We are in the same class.

sample: My **best friend** is Jasur. He is sixteen and we are in the same class. He is very **kind** and **funny**. He is also **clever**, so he **helps** me with maths. Jasur is **honest** and I **trust** him. We like playing football **together** after school. I am happy because he is my friend.

title: My country
grammar: to be / It is famous for ...
questions: Where is your country?
What is it famous for?
What do you like about it?
sample: I live in Uzbekistan. It is in **Central Asia**. The capital is Tashkent. The **population** is about thirty- seven million. Uzbekistan is **famous for** its **ancient** cities: Samarkand, Bukhara and Khiva. Many **tourists** come here every year. The weather is **sunny** and our **fruit** is very sweet. People are **hospitable**. I am proud of my country.

title: My hometown
questions: Where is your hometown?
Is it big or small?
What is there in your hometown?
sample: My **hometown** is Fergana. It is not a very big city, but it is **beautiful**. There are many trees and **parks**. There is a big **market** in the centre. The **streets** are clean and **quiet**. Tashkent is **noisy**, but my **hometown** is not. I like it because my family and friends live there.

title: My family and friends
questions: Is your family big or small?
Do you have many friends?
When do you see your friends?

phrases.en: I have a big / small family.

sample: I have a big family. I live with my parents, my brother and my sister. We are very **close**. I also have many **relatives**, and we **visit** them at weekends. I have a lot of friends too. Some are my **classmates** and some are my **neighbours**. They are **friendly**. I **spend time** with them after school.

title: Describing people
questions: What do you look like?
What colour are your eyes and hair?
What kind of person are you?
sample: I am quite **tall** and **slim**. I have got **short** **dark** **hair** and brown **eyes**. My sister is **short** and she has got long **hair**. She looks like our mother. I am a quiet person and I am a little **shy**. But I am **hard-working**. My friends say I am kind.

title: My hobby
questions: What is your hobby?
When do you do it?
Why do you like it?
sample: My **hobby** is **drawing**. I like **drawing** people and animals. In my **free time** I draw in my room. I usually do it in the evening, after my homework. It is **interesting** and **relaxing**. I am good at it, and my teacher likes my pictures. **Drawing** is my **favourite** activity and I really **enjoy** it.

title: Free time and weekends
uzTitle: Bo'sh vaqt va dam olish kunlari
questions: What do you do in your free time?
What do you do at weekends?
Who do you spend your weekends with?
sample: I love **weekends**. On Saturday I **usually** help my mother at home. Then I **relax** and **watch** films. On Sunday I **often** **go for a walk** in the park with my friends. **Sometimes** we play football. I **never** get up early at the **weekend**. In the evening I do my homework. It is fun to have free time.

title: My daily routine
questions: What time do you get up?
What do you do in the morning?
What do you do in the evening?
sample: I **get up** at seven o'clock every day. I wash my face and **have breakfast**. Then I **go to school** at eight. My lessons finish at two o'clock. After that, I **come home** and have lunch. In the evening I **do my homework** and help my mother. I **go to bed** at eleven. I don't **go to bed** **late**.

title: Time and days of the week
questions: What time is it now?
What do you do on Mondays?
What is your favourite day?
sample: It is **half past** eight now. I am **busy** on **weekdays**. On **Mondays** and Wednesdays I have English lessons **in the afternoon**. On Tuesdays I play football at five **o'clock**. **In the morning** I am always at school. My favourite day is Saturday because I am free. **At night** I read a book and sleep.

title: My family member's daily routine
questions: Who do you want to talk about?
What time does he or she get up?
What does he or she do every day?
sample: I want to talk about my father. He gets up at six o'clock **every day**. He has breakfast and leaves home at seven. He **drives** to **work**. He **works** in a bank. He comes back at six in the evening. He is usually **tired**, so he **rests** and watches TV. He doesn't **cook**, but he helps my mother at weekends.

title: Jobs
questions: What does your father do?
What does your mother do?
Where do they work?
sample: My father is a **driver**. He works for a big company. He likes his **job**. My mother is a **teacher**. She works in a school near our house. She teaches maths. It is a difficult **job**, but she loves children. My aunt is a **doctor** and she works in a **hospital**. My grandmother is a **housewife**.

title: My school
questions: Where is your school?
What is your school like?
What do you like about your school?

phrases.en: There are ... pupils in my class.

sample: I study at school number twenty-five. It is near my house. I am in the tenth grade. My school is big. There are thirty **classrooms**, a **library**, a **gym** and a **canteen**. There are twenty-eight **pupils** in my class. We have six **lessons** a day. We wear a **uniform**. I like my school because my teachers are kind.

title: My favourite subject
questions: What subjects do you study?
What is your favourite subject?
Which subject is difficult for you?
sample: I study many **subjects** at school: **maths**, **history**, **English**, biology and others. My favourite **subject** is **English**. It is interesting and **easy** for me. I am good at it and I get good **marks**. I don't like physics because it is **difficult** for me. **History** is not **boring**. I like it too.

title: Learning English
questions: Why do you learn English?
How do you learn English?
What is difficult for you in English?
sample: I **learn** English because I want to study abroad. I have English lessons three times a week. I **learn** ten new **words** every day and write them in my notebook. I use a **dictionary** on my phone. I **practise** speaking with my friend. **Grammar** is easy for me, but speaking is difficult. I make **mistakes**, but it is OK.

title: My teacher
questions: Who is your favourite teacher?
What does he or she teach?
Why do you like him or her?
sample: My favourite teacher is Nodira opa. She **teaches** English. She is about thirty-five years old. She is kind and **patient**, but sometimes she is **strict**. She **explains** everything very well and answers all our **questions**. She gives us **homework** every day. She is very **smart**. All the pupils **respect** her, and I want to be like her.

title: Holidays: what I usually do
questions: Where do you usually go on holiday?
What do you do there?
What is there in that place?
sample: Every **summer** my family and I go to the **mountains** near Tashkent. We usually go in July. We stay in a small **hotel** for one week. There is a **swimming pool**, a café and a playground there. There is also a beautiful **lake**. I **swim** every day and walk in the **fresh air**. I love this **holiday** because it is not hot there.

title: Seasons and weather
questions: What is the weather like today?
What is your favourite season?
What do you do in that season?
sample: There are four seasons in Uzbekistan. In summer it is very **hot**. In **winter** it is **cold** and sometimes there is **snow**. My favourite season is **spring**. It is **warm** and everything is green. There is some **rain**, but I like it. In **spring** we celebrate Navruz and I walk a lot. I don't like **autumn** very much.

title: My home
questions: Do you live in a house or a flat?
How many rooms are there?
What is there in your home?

phrases.en: There is a ... next to the...

sample: I live in a **flat** with my family. It is on the third **floor**. There are four rooms in our **flat**: a **living** **room**, two **bedrooms** and a **kitchen**. There is also a **bathroom**. The **kitchen** is next to the **living** **room**. There is a big table in the **kitchen**. We don't have a **garden**, but there are flowers on the balcony.

title: My room
grammar: o'rin predloglari: next to, between, under
questions: Is your room big or small?
What is there in your room?
Where is your bed?

phrases.en: There is a ... in the corner.

sample: My room is small, but I like it. There is a **bed** **next to** the window. My **desk** is **opposite** the **bed**, and there is a lamp on it. The **wardrobe** is **between** the door and the **desk**. On the wall there is a **shelf** with my books. My bag is usually **under** the **desk**. My room is always clean.

title: My neighbourhood
questions: What is there near your house?
Is there a park near your house?
Do you like your neighbourhood?

phrases.en: There is a ... near my house.

sample: I like my **neighbourhood**. There is a small **shop** **near** my house and a **pharmacy** next to it. There is a **mosque** and a **playground** too. The **bus stop** is five minutes from my house. There isn't a cinema, and the big market is **far from** us. My neighbours are friendly, and we always help each other.

title: Shopping
questions: Where do you usually go shopping?
What do you usually buy?
Do you like shopping?
sample: I usually go shopping with my mother on Sundays. We go to the market because fruit and vegetables are **cheap** there. I ask the **seller**, "How much is it?" Then my mother **pays**. We **buy** bread and milk in the **supermarket** near our house. I like shopping for clothes, but they are **expensive**, so I don't **buy** them often.

title: My favourite dish
questions: What is your favourite food?
Who cooks it in your family?
How often do you eat it?
sample: My favourite **dish** is plov. It is made of **rice**, **meat**, **carrots** and oil. My father cooks it very well. We eat plov every Sunday with the whole family. It is very **delicious**, and when I am **hungry** I can eat two **plates**! We eat it with **salad** and drink green tea. I think it is the best **dish** in the world.

title: Popular food in my country
questions: What food is popular in your country?
What do people eat on holidays?
What do people usually drink?
sample: Uzbek **national** food is very **popular**. The most **popular** dish is plov, but people also love somsa, manti, lagman and shashlik. We eat a lot of **bread**. Uzbek **bread** is round and very tasty. People usually drink green tea. When a **guest** comes, we put **sweets** and fruit on the table. You should **try** our **soup**, shurpa, in a **national** **restaurant**.

title: Meals
questions: What do you usually have for breakfast?
Where do you have lunch?
What time do you have dinner?
sample: For **breakfast** I usually have **eggs**, bread and **cheese**, and I drink **tea**. I have **lunch** at school at one o'clock. I often eat soup or rice with **vegetables**. We have **dinner** together at seven in the evening. My mother cooks something hot. I don't eat **fast food** very often because it is not healthy.

title: Cooking
questions: Can you cook?
What can you cook?
Who cooks in your family?
sample: I can cook a little. I can make eggs and salad. First, I **cut** tomatoes with a **knife**. Then, I **fry** eggs in a **pan** and put some **salt**. It is easy and **tasty**. I can't cook plov or soup. My mother cooks best in our family. She can cook everything. I want to learn from her.

title: Clothes
questions: What are you wearing today?
What clothes do you like?
What do you wear in winter?
sample: Today I am **wearing** a white **shirt**, black **trousers** and black **shoes**. It is my school uniform. At home I usually **wear** a T- **shirt** and jeans because they are **comfortable**. In winter I **wear** a warm **jacket** and a hat. My sister likes **fashionable** clothes. She often **wears** **dresses**. I like simple clothes.

title: Colours and favourite things
questions: What is your favourite colour?
What colour is your bag?
What is your favourite thing?
sample: My favourite **colour** is **blue**. It is the **colour** of the sky. My bag is **blue** and my phone is **blue** too. I don't like very **bright** **colours** like **red**. My favourite **thing** is my **watch**. It is black and **green**. It is a **present** from my grandfather. I wear it every day and always carry it with me.

title: Animals and pets
questions: Do you have a pet?
What is your favourite animal?
Why do you like it?
sample: I have got a **pet**. It is a small white **cat**. Her name is Mosh. She is two years old and she is very **cute**. I **feed** her every day and **look after** her. She likes milk and fish. She sleeps on my bed. My favourite wild animal is the lion. I sometimes see lions at the **zoo**.

title: Sport
questions: Do you like sport?
What sport do you do?
How often do you do it?

phrases.en: I do it twice a week.
phrases.uz: Men buni haftada ikki marta qilaman.

sample: I like sport very much. I play **football** with my friends **twice a week**. We have a small **team**. Sometimes we **win** and sometimes we **lose**, but it is always fun. In summer I go **swimming**. I also watch **matches** on TV. My favourite **team** is Pakhtakor. Sport is good because it makes me **strong** and healthy.

title: Music
questions: Do you like music?
What kind of music do you like?
Who is your favourite singer?

phrases.en: I listen to music every day.

sample: I like music very much. I **listen to** music every day on my phone with **headphones**. I like pop music and Uzbek **songs**. My favourite **singer** is Sevara Nazarkhan. She has a beautiful **voice** and I like her **songs**. I can't **sing** well, and I can't play the **guitar**, but I want to learn. I don't like very **loud** music.

title: Films and cartoons
questions: Do you like watching films?
What kind of films do you like?
Where do you watch films?
sample: I love watching **films**. I like comedies because I like **laughing**. I also like **cartoons**. I hate **scary** **films**. I can't sleep after them! My favourite **film** is "Home Alone". It is very funny and **exciting**. I usually watch **films** on my phone or on TV. Sometimes I go to the **cinema** with my friends at the weekend.

title: Books and reading
questions: Do you like reading?
What kind of books do you read?
When do you read?
sample: I like reading. I usually read **before bed**. I read about ten **pages** a day. I like short stories and **fairy** **tales**. I don't read **poems** very often. My favourite **writer** is Abdulla Qodiriy. I **borrow** books from the school library. Reading is **useful** because I learn new words. Now I am reading an easy book in English.

title: My phone and the internet
questions: How often do you use your phone?
What do you use it for?
What apps do you like?
sample: I use my **phone** every day. I use it to **call** my parents and **send** **messages** to my friends. My favourite **app** is Telegram. I also watch videos and **download** music. I spend about three hours **online** every day. I use the **internet** for my English lessons too. I think I can't live without my **phone**, but that is not very good.

title: Games
questions: Do you like playing games?
What games do you play?
Who do you play with?
sample: I like playing **games**. I play **chess** with my grandfather. The **rules** are not easy, and he is usually the **winner**. I also play **computer games**, but only one hour a day. My favourite **game** has fifty **levels**. In summer I play **outside** with my friends. We play football and hide-and-seek. **Games** are fun.

title: Things I can do
questions: What can you do well?
What can't you do?
What do you want to learn?
sample: I can do many things. I can **ride a bike** and I can **run** **fast**. I can swim **a little**. I can **draw** very **well**. I can speak Uzbek and Russian, and I can **count** to one hundred in English. But I can't **dance** and I can't drive a car. I want to learn to play the piano.

title: Transport
questions: How do you go to school?
How long does it take?
What transport do you like?

phrases.en: There is a lot of traffic.

sample: I usually go to school **on foot** because it is near my house. It **takes** ten minutes. When I go to the city centre, I **take** the **bus** or the **metro**. The **metro** is fast and the **ticket** is cheap. My father goes to work by **car**. In the morning there is a lot of **traffic**. I don't like **taxis** because they are expensive.

title: My favourite place
questions: What is your favourite place in your city?
What can you do there?
How often do you go there?

phrases.en: It is a great place to...

sample: My favourite **place** in my city is the central park. It is in the **centre** of Tashkent. There are many trees, **benches** and a big **fountain** there. You can walk, ride a bike or eat ice cream in a **café**. I **meet** my friends there every Saturday. At weekends it is **crowded**, but I like it. It is a great **place** to relax.

title: Health
questions: What do you do to be healthy?
What should people eat?
What do you do when you are ill?
sample: **Health** is very important. I try to do **exercise** every morning. I drink a lot of **water** and eat fruit. I **sleep** eight hours. I always **wash** my hands before I eat. You should eat vegetables and you shouldn't eat a lot of sweets. When I am **ill** or have a **headache**, I stay in bed and take **medicine**.

title: What is happening now
questions: What are you doing now?
What are your family doing now?
What can you see in the picture?

phrases.en: In the picture I can see...

sample: **Now** I am sitting at my desk and speaking English. My mother is cooking dinner in the kitchen. My father is watching TV. My brother is not studying **at the moment**. He is playing a game. In the **picture** on my wall I can see a family. They are **standing** in a garden and **talking**. A girl **in the** **middle** is smiling.

title: My last day: yesterday
questions: What did you do yesterday?
What time did you get up?
What did you do in the evening?
sample: **Yesterday** I **got up** at seven o'clock. I **had** breakfast and **went** to school. I **had** five lessons. After school I **came** home and **had** lunch. Then I **did** my homework and helped my mother. **Last night** I **watched** a film with my family. I didn't play computer games. I **went** to bed at eleven. It was a good day.

title: What my family member did yesterday
questions: Who do you want to talk about?
What did he or she do yesterday?
Was he or she busy?
sample: I want to talk about my mother. Yesterday she got up at six and **made** breakfast for us. Then she **cleaned** the house. **In the afternoon** she went to the market and **bought** fruit and meat. She **met** her friend there. In the evening she **cooked** plov and **called** my grandmother. She didn't rest at all. She **was** very tired.

title: Last weekend
questions: What did you do last weekend?
Where did you go?
Did you have a good time?
sample: **Last weekend** was great. On Saturday I **slept** until ten o'clock. Then I **visited** my grandparents in the village. We **ate** shashlik in the garden. I **played** with my cousins and **saw** their new dog. On Sunday I **stayed** at home. I did my homework and watched TV. We had a great time. It was **fun**.

title: My last holiday (1 minute)
questions: Where did you go on your last holiday?
Who did you go with?
What did you do there?

phrases.en: I want to go there again.

sample: **Last summer** I went to Samarkand with my family. We **travelled** by train. The **trip** took two hours. We stayed in a small hotel for three days. The **weather** was hot and sunny. We visited Registan and **took photos**. We ate Samarkand bread and plov. I **swam** in the hotel pool every evening. I bought **souvenirs** for my friends. It was a **wonderful** holiday, and I want to go there again.

title: My childhood
questions: Where were you born?
What were you like when you were a child?
What did you like doing?

phrases.en: When I was a child, I...

sample: I **was born** in Bukhara in 2010. When I was a **child**, I was very **naughty**. I went to **kindergarten** near our house. My favourite **toy** was a red car. I played outside with my friends all day. I **could** ride a bike when I was five. My grandmother told me stories every night. I had a **happy** **childhood**.

title: My last birthday
questions: When is your birthday?
How did you celebrate your last birthday?
What presents did you get?
sample: My **birthday** is on the fifth of May. Last year I had a small **party** at home. I **invited** six friends. My mother made a big **cake** with sixteen **candles**. We ate, listened to music and **danced**. My parents **gave** me a new phone, and I **got** books from my friends. I was very happy. It was the best day of the year.

title: My hobby (1 minute)
questions: What is your hobby and when did you start it?
How often do you do it?
Why is it important for you?
sample: I want to talk about my hobby. My hobby is playing chess. I **started** it two years **ago**. My grandfather taught me. **At first** it was difficult and I always lost. But I played every day and **improved** my **skills**. **Now** I can win against my father! I play three times a week at a chess club. Last month I played in a school competition and got second place. I was very **proud**. Chess helps me to think and relax. **In the future** I want to be a champion.

title: A place I visited
questions: What interesting place did you visit?
When did you go there?
What did you see?

phrases.en: It is in the heart of...

sample: Last year I visited Khiva with my class. It is a very **old** city in Uzbekistan. We saw Ichan-Kala. It is in the heart of the city. The **buildings** and **walls** are **huge**. Our **guide** told us about the **history** of Khiva. I learned a lot. It was **amazing**, and I still **remember** that day.

title: Navruz
questions: What is your favourite holiday?
When do people celebrate it?
What do people do on that day?
sample: My favourite holiday is Navruz. We **celebrate** it on the twenty-first of **March**. It is the **beginning** of spring. People cook sumalak all night. It is an old **tradition**. Women and girls wear **national** **clothes**. There are **concerts** in the parks. We visit our relatives and **wish** them health. Everybody is happy and we spend the day **together**.

title: New Year
questions: How do you celebrate New Year?
What do you eat?
What did you do last New Year?
sample: We celebrate **New Year** on the thirty-first of **December**. Before the holiday we **decorate** the **New** **Year tree** at home. My mother cooks a lot of food and salads. At **midnight** we watch **fireworks** and make a **wish**. Last **New Year** I stayed up until two o'clock! I said "Happy **New Year**!" to all my friends. I love this holiday.

title: Gifts
questions: Do you like giving presents?
What was the best present you got?
What do you give your mother?
sample: I like giving presents. On the eighth of March I gave my mother **flowers** and **perfume**. I **chose** them with my father. It was a **surprise**, and she was very happy. She **thanked** us. The best **gift** I got was a bike. My parents gave it to me when I was ten. It was very **special** for me.

title: Guests at home
questions: Do guests often come to your house?
What do you do when guests come?
What do you put on the table?

phrases.en: Guests often come to our house.

sample: Uzbek people love **guests**. **Guests** often come to our house at weekends. When **guests** come, we **welcome** them and say " **Welcome**!" My mother puts a **tablecloth** with bread, fruit and sweets. I **bring** tea and **pour** it for the **guests**. I am always **polite**. Then we eat plov together. When they go home, we **say goodbye** at the door.

title: Plans for tomorrow and next weekend
uzTitle: Ertangi kun va dam olish kuni rejalari
questions: What are you going to do tomorrow?
What are you going to do next weekend?
Who are you going to meet?

phrases.en: Next weekend we are going to...
phrases.uz: Keyingi dam olish kuni biz ... qilmoqchimiz.

sample: I have many **plans**. **Tomorrow** I am going to get up early because I have a **test**. I am going to **prepare** for it tonight. After school I am going to **finish** my project. **Next weekend** I am **free**, so I am going to meet my friends. We are going to play football. **Maybe** I will go to the cinema too.

title: Summer plans
questions: What are you going to do this summer?
Where would you like to go?
What do you want to learn?

phrases.en: This summer I am going to...

sample: **This summer** I am going to do many things. In June I have **exams**, so I am going to **study**. In July I am going to **rest** and **travel** with my family. I would like to see the **sea**. In August I am going to take an English **course**. I also want to learn to swim well. I **hope** it will be a great summer.

title: My future job
questions: What do you want to be?
Why do you want this job?
What will you do to get it?

phrases.en: I think it is a good job.

sample: I want to be a **programmer** in the **future**. I like computers and I am good at maths. I think it is a good job because it is interesting and the **salary** is high. My **dream** is to work in a big company. After school I will **enter** **university**. I will **study hard** and learn English well. I hope I will **become** a good **programmer**.

title: A country I would like to visit
questions: Which country would you like to visit?
Why?
What would you like to do there?
sample: There are many beautiful countries in the **world**. I would like to visit **Turkey**. I have never been there. I'd like to **fly** to Istanbul by **plane**. I want to see the old city and the sea. I like Turkish **culture** and Turkish films. I also want to **try** Turkish food. The **people** there are friendly. **One day** I will go there with my family.

title: City and village
questions: Do you live in a city or a village?
Which is better: a city or a village?
Where do you want to live?
sample: I live in a city, but my grandparents live in a village. The city is **bigger** and **more interesting** **than** the village. There are more shops, cinemas and schools. But **life** in the city is **more expensive**. The village is **quieter** and **cleaner** **than** the city. The air is **better** there. I prefer the city now, but I want to live in a village when I am old.

title: All about me: final talk
questions: Can you tell me about yourself?
What did you do last year?
What are your plans?

phrases.en: Let me tell you about myself.

sample: Let me tell you about **myself**. My name is Aziz and I am sixteen. I am from Tashkent. I live with my parents, my brother and my sister. I am a student and my favourite subject is English. I am friendly and hard-working. In my free time I play football and read books. **Last year** I started this speaking book. At first I couldn't speak **easily**, but I **practised** every day and improved my English. **Next** **year** I am going to take an exam. My **goal** is to study at a good university. That's all about me. Thank you for **listening**!
